roughness.definition: Areal Sa/Sq relative to the mean plane; Sz is sampled peak-to-valley, not PNG encoding range.

surface.acf_definition: Circular height covariance / Sq^2; nearest-radius shells at their mean actual radii; first 1/e crossing with linear interpolation, no Gaussian fit

facet_model.definition: Projected-area statistics of the original periodic triangular facets; float64 analytic Snell/Fresnel, no native ray execution

surface.interpretation: Height PSD is not angular optical power. Phase RMS need not be small; no first-order height-PSD haze formula is assumed.
